o.text: Ultimately a derivation from Proto-Turkic *eg- (“to bend”). Cognate with Turkish eğri.
From Persian توت (tut). Ultimate origin uncertain.

Etymology tree
Latin nūlla
Italian nullabor.
German Nullbor.
Russian ноль (nolʹ)bor.
Azerbaijani nol
Borrowed from Russian ноль (nolʹ).

From Proto-Common Turkic *kadïr- (“to bend, turn, twist”).
Unrelated to Turkish kayırmak (“to favor, to protect”), which is cognate with Turkish kaygı, Azerbaijani qayğı etc. instead (from Proto-Turkic *kadgu).

Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish بوداق (budaq), from Proto-Turkic *būtak, a derivation from Proto-Turkic *būta-. Cognate with Turkish budak, Turkmen pudak, Bashkir ботаҡ (butaq), Chuvash пӑта (păt̬a, “nail”), etc.
From Classical Persian سَادَه لَوْح (sāda lawh).
